Grilled chicken Alfredo pasta is a delicious and popular dish that combines tender grilled chicken with creamy Alfredo sauce and pasta.  Ingredients: . 3 boneless, skinless chicken breasts marinated with 👇🏻 . 1 tbsp smoked paprika  . 1/2 tbsp black pepper  . 1/2 tbsp salt  . 1/2 garlic powder  . 1/2 tbsp dried parsley  . A pinch of rosemary  Penne pasta (boiled)  Alfredo sauce : . 4 tbsp butter  . 1/4 cup all purpose flour  . 8 oz milk  . 1/2 cup heavy cream  . 3 tbsp cream cheese  . 1/3 cup mozzarella cheese  . 1/3 parmesan cheese . 1 tbsp red chili flakes  . Salt and pepper to taste  . 1 tbsp dried parsley  . 1 tbsp oregano  .Grill the chicken for about 6-8 minutes per side or until cooked through.  Remove from the grill and let it rest for a few minutes. Then, slice the chicken into thin strips. . In a large skillet, heat the butter over medium heat.  . Add all purpose flour, make it smooth make sure the heat is low. Add milk keep stirring add cream cheese. Add heavy cream. Stir continuously until the sauce is smooth and creamy. . Add all the seasonings. . Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss it in the Alfredo sauce until well coated. .Add mozzarella cheese and grated Parmesan  . Place the sliced grilled chicken on top of the pasta. . Garnish with  parsley. hot honey garlic chicken tenders 🔥🍯✨ - crispy, golden brown tenders coated in a garlicky sweet and spicy sauce is pure perfection with each bite!  what you’ll need:  Chicken Tenders  Dry Mixture  • 1 1/2 cups flour  • 1/4 cup corn starch  • 1 tsp baking powder • 1 tsp salt  • 1/2 smoked paprika  • 1/2 tsp garlic powder • 1/2 tsp onion powder  • 1/2 tsp black pepper  Wet Mixture  • 1 1/2 pound chicken tenders  • 1 cup buttermilk • 2 tbsp hot sauce  • 1/2 tsp salt  • 1/2 tsp smoked paprika  • 1/4 tsp black pepper  • 1/4 tsp garlic powder  • 1/4 tsp onion powder  • 2-3 cups neutral oil, for frying  Hot Honey Garlic Sauce  • 1/2 cup hot sauce • 1/2 cup honey  • 2 tbsp butter  • 4 garlic cloves, minced  • 1/2 tsp smoked paprika  • 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper  here’s how to make it:  Chicken Tenders - In a bowl, mix together the tenders and all of the wet mixture ingredients (except for the oil). Cover and marinade for 1-4 hours or overnight in the fridge. In a separate bowl, whisk together all of the dry mixture ingredients. Mix in 2-3 tbsp of the wet mixture to form a crumbly texture. Individually, coat each tender in the dry mixture. Transfer to a wire rack to rest for 10-12 min. Heat oil in a frying pan to 350F. In batches, fry the tenders, 3-4 min per side or until golden brown. Transfer to paper towel lined baking sheet. Hot Honey Garlic Sauce - in a saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. Add and sauté the garlic until fragrant, 1-2 min. Pour in the hot sauce, honey and spices. Stir to combine and bring to a low boil. Cook sauce for 4-5 min while stirring to thicken up slightly. Remove from heat. Set aside. Assembly - place fried tenders in a large bowl. Pour sauce over tenders and mix to coat. Serve coated tenders with sauce of choice and enjoy!!  #hothoney #chickentenders #FoodTok #garlic #Recipes

Garlic Parmesan chicken pasta ✨ Ingredients  Chicken  - 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut in half - 1 tsp roasted garlic powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp Italian seasoning  - 1 tsp garlic and herb seasoning  - Salt to taste - 1 tbsp avocado oil (for cooking) - 1 tbsp unsalted butter (for cooking) Sauce + pasta - 14 oz fettuccine pasta  - 1 1/2 cup heavy cream - 6 tbsp unsalted butter - 1/4 cup pasta water - 7 garlic cloves (minced) - 1 shallot (minced) - 1 1/4 cups Parmesan cheese (grated)  - 1 tbsp freshly chopped parsley  - 1 1/2 tsp oregano  - 1 1/2 tsp roasted garlic powder - 1 tsp red chili flakes - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions  - In a large bowl coat chicken breast with about 2 tsp of olive oil, seasonings, salt and mix until evenly coated. Cover and set aside for 30 minutes to marinate. - Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add avocado oil and 1 tbsp of butter. - Sear chicken for 5 minutes per side until a golden crust forms. Deglaze pan with a little chicken broth, lower the heat, cover, and simmer until internal temperature reaches 155F. - Remove chicken from pan, cover in foil, and place into oven set warm. Pasta  - Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Salt it heavily. - Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente. - Reserve at least 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain. Sauce - To the same pan (medium heat) add butter. - Sauté shallot for 1–2 minutes until soft. - Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant (about 30 seconds). - Season with oregano, garlic powder, chili flakes, salt, and black pepper. Mix until well combined and fragrant  -  Pour in heavy cream and mix  - Simmer gently for 3–5 minutes until slightly thickened. - Lower heat and stir in Parmesan  cheese and pasta water. Mix until well combined. Taste and adjust for seasonings. - Add cooked fettuccine and parsley, mixing until well coated. - Stir in an additional ¼ cup Parmesan until fully combined. - Finish with chopped parsley. - Add sliced chicken on top of pasta  - Finish with extra Parmesan, cracked pepper, or chili flakes if desired. • • • #recipes #pasta #dinnerideas #chickenrecipe #foodideas

This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out.  #chickenandgravy #easyrecipe #dinner #onepanmeal #chickenrecipes

HOT HONEY GROUND BEEF BOWLS 🍯🌶️ all I have to say is this one’s viral for a reason. Here’s how I made mine! Ingredients: (makes 4 bowls) 1 1/2 lbs sweet potato (680 g) peeled, diced into ~1/4” cubes salt, pepper, cinnamon - to taste 1 lb 93/7 lean ground beef 1 tbsp tomato paste (16 g) 1 tbsp taco seasoning 2 cups 2% low fat cottage cheese (452 g) 4 small avocados (400 g) 4 tbsp hot honey (84 g) Instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 425F and line a half baking sheet with parchment. 2. Add diced sweet potatoes, lightly spray with cooking spray and season with salt, pepper and a little cinnamon. Bake for 30 minutes, flipping and seasoning again halfway. 3. While potatoes are baking, make the taco beef. Heat a frying pan on medium high, add ground beef and cook, breaking apart into small pieces until fully cooked (~5 min). Drain any excess liquid. 4. Add tomato paste, taco seasoning, a splash of water and cook for 1-2 more minutes, stirring everything together. Remove from heat. 5. Build your bowl with sweet potato, taco beef, cottage cheese and fresh avocado. Finish it off with a drizzle of hot honey and enjoy! ✨ For the full printable recipe + nutrition, search 🔍 “hot honey ground beef bowls” at myproteinpantry.com or link 🔗 in my bio! 🫶🏼 #highprotein #easyrecipes #healthyfood #healthylifestyle #healthyrecipes #hothoney #beef #sweetpotato #avocado

Hot honey chicken sliders 🍔✨🍯 Ingredients  Chicken  - 1lb chicken breast, cut in half to create smaller pieces  - 1 1/3 cups buttermilk  - 1/4 cup hot sauce - 1/4 cup pickle juice  - 1 1/2 cup all purpose flour  - 1/2 cup cornstarch  - 2 tsp garlic powder  - 2 tsp onion powder  - 2 tsp cayenne powder (use less if desired) - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp mustard powder  - 1 tsp salt - 1/2 tsp black pepper  - 1/2 tsp msg (optional) - Oil for frying  - Slider buns Hot honey sauce - 2 tbsp unsalted butter  - 1/3 cup hot sauce  - 1/2 cup honey - 1/2 tsp brown sugar  - 1/8 tsp salt  Instructions: - In a bowl, combine chicken pieces, buttermilk, seasonings, pickle juice and hot sauce. Let sit for 3 hours (or overnight in the fridge for best results). - In another bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, mustard powder, cayenne, salt, and pepper. - Heat oil to 350°F (175°C). - Remove chicken from marinade, letting excess drip off. Dredge in seasoned flour mixture, pressing to coat well. Rest the floured chicken for 10 minutes before frying  - Fry in batches 4–6 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. Drain on a wire rack or paper towels.  - In a small saucepan combine honey, butter, and hot sauce. Mix until well combined. Let it simmer for 3-4 minutes then remove from heat - Brush chicken with hot honey sauce on both sides - Slice buns horizontally and brush with butter, place into a pan on medium high heat and toast until slightly golden brown.  - Mix melted butter, parsley and garlic powder. Sheet Pan Parmesan Garlic Chicken Thighs are an easy and delicious dinner!  INGREDIENTS  2 lb boneless chicken thighs  Buffalo Wild Wings Parmesan Garlic sauce  1 tsp each salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, and onion powder  2 tsp each garlic powder and smoked paprika  Small head of broccoli, chopped  24 oz baby potatoes  1 onion, sliced  Olive oil   Parmesan cheese  INSTRUCTIONS  Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F. Spray a large sheet pan with cooking spray.  Wash the baby potatoes and quarter them. Slice an onion and chop your broccoli. Be sure to leave the broccoli in slightly larger pieces. Add all of the veggies to the sheet pan and drizzle some olive oil over them. Season the veggies with about half of the seasoning blend.  Next, add the chicken thighs to a bowl and season with the rest of the seasoning. Add enough Parmesan Garlic sauce to coat the chicken. Stir until the chicken is well coated in seasoning and sauce.  Bake at 400 degrees F for about 35 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of at least 185 degrees F. Broil for just a few minutes if desired. Top everything with some shredded Parmesan cheese. Enjoy!  #sheetpanmeal #dinner #parmesangarlic #chickenthighs #easyrecipes

INGREDIENTS Chicken & Marinade 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs 1 lemon, zested ⅛ cup soy sauce ¼ cup maple syrup 1 tbsp garlic powder 1 tbsp smoked paprika Glaze 2 tbsp butter 4 cloves garlic, minced ½ cup maple syrup ⅓ cup soy sauce 2 tbsp rice vinegar 3 tsp Momofuku chili oil 1 tsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (slurry) INSTRUCTIONS 1.In a bowl add chicken thighs and season with soy sauce, maple syrup, lemon zest, garlic powder, and smoked paprika, coat well. 2.Preheat the air fryer to 400°F. Place thighs in a single layer and cook for 15 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and cooked through (165°F internal temp). 3.Make glaze: In a saucepan, melt butter. Add garlic and cook until fragrant. Stir in maple syrup, soy, vinegar, and chili. Simmer for 3-4 minutes. Stir in slurry and cook until sticky and glossy. 4.Baste & finish: Add cooked chicken thighs to the glaze, toss to coat, 5.Serve: Drizzle extra glaze over the chicken serve over rice and veggies and enjoy!

crispy chicken caesar salad croissants 🥗🥐 these over the wraps anyday omg 😣     recipe:   ingredients- 4 thin sliced chicken breasts 1 cup all-purpose flour (120g) seasonings (to taste)- salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, italian seasoning, chili powder, kinder bold chicken seasoning blend for the wet mixture- 2 eggs 2–3 tbsp heavy cream (30–45g) 1–2 tbsp pickle juice for the coating- 1½ cups panko breadcrumbs (90g) 2–3 tbsp grated parmesan for the caesar salad- romaine lettuce, chopped croutons extra parmesan other ingredients- 4 large croissants oil for frying garlic butter- 2 tbsp melted butter (28g) 1 clove garlic, minced parsley extra parmesan caesar dressing- 1 cup mayo (240g) ½ cup finely grated parmesan (50g) 2–3 cloves garlic, minced 2 tbsp lemon juice (30g) 1 tbsp dijon mustard (15g) 1 tsp worcestershire sauce ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper ¼ cup olive oil (60g) 2–4 tbsp water (to thin if needed) instructions: season the chicken generously with your spices. in one bowl, mix the flour with any remaining seasoning. in another bowl, whisk together the eggs, heavy cream, and pickle juice. in a third bowl, combine the panko and parmesan. coat each piece of chicken in the flour, then the egg mixture, then the panko mixture. let the breaded chicken rest for 5–10 minutes. fry in oil over medium heat until golden brown and cooked through, about 4–5 minutes per side. transfer to a wire rack. for the dressing, whisk together the mayo, parmesan, garlic, lemon juice, dijon, worcestershire, salt, and pepper. slowly whisk in the olive oil, then add water until smooth and pourable. toss the chopped romaine with some of the caesar dressing. add croutons and extra parmesan. slice the croissants in half and spread a little caesar dressing on both sides. add the crispy chicken, top with the caesar salad mixture, and sprinkle with more parmesan. mix together the melted butter, garlic, and parsley. brush the tops of the croissants with the garlic butter and finish with extra parmesan. serve immediately and enjoyyyy    #caesarsalad #crispychicken #croissant #Recipe #EasyRecipe

⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per 1 meal prep: Protein: 40g Carbs: 87g Fat: 8g Calories: 585 Ingredients per 2 servings (makes 2 meal preps): Chicken - 1lb chicken thigh, boneless, skinless, raw - 2 tsp salt - 2 tsp black pepper - 1/4 cup cornstarch - 1/3 second spray oil - 1 tsp sesame seeds -1 green onion Soy Glaze Sauce - 2.5 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tbsp oyster sauce - 2.5 tbsp honey - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic Cucumber Salad - 2 Persian cucumbers - 2 tsp salt - 1.5 tbsp rice vinegar - 2 tsp brown sugar - 1/2 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tsp sesame seeds 1.5 cup cooked rice How to make it yourself: 1. Dice your cucumbers into thin circles. 2. Lay your chicken thighs flat, season with salt and pepper, and coat evenly with cornstarch on both sides 3. In a bowl, mixed together, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, and minced garlic to make your sauce. 4. On a pan coated with spray oil on medium heat, cook your chicken until golden brown, crispy on both sides, and cooked through. 5. Remove the cooked chicken from the pan and pour in your sauce to let it simmer for 45 seconds the add back in your chicken and let it coat the sauce for a minute then quickly remove. 6. In a bowl, mix together your sliced cucumbers with salt. Let it sit for 15 minutes until the excess liquid drains from the cucumbers. 7. Remove the excess liquid from the cucumbers and rinse the cucumbers with water. 8. Pat dry the cucumbers and add them into a bowl with rice vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, and sesame seeds and mix well to make your salad. 9. In a meal prep container, add 1/2 your steamed rice, 1/2 your cucumber salad, and 1/2 your chicken optionally topped with sesame seeds and sliced green onions. 10. Pro tip: when meal prepping to re-heat, make sure to put your salad & meat into separate ziploc bags to avoid getting the rice soggy. When ready to eat, microwave the rice with a wet paper towel first to get it steamed, then add in your meat and microwave till warm, and finally add your salad to preserve the crunch and enjoy! 📩 Save this Soy Glazed Chicken recipe to make for later! #highprotein #lowcaloriemeals #mealprep #mealplan #healthyrecipe #weightlossmeals #asianfood #chicken

Buffalo chicken cheesy garlic bread ✨🥖 Ingredients Chicken - 1.5 lb boneless chicken breast, diced - 2 tsp Fire & Smoke Society Chicka Licka Bam Bam seasoning  - 2 tsp garlic powder  - 2 tsp onion powder - 1 tsp paprika  - Salt and black pepper to taste - Fresh parsley, chopped (for garnish) - 1/4 cup buffalo sauce  -  3 tbsp Mexican crema or sour cream  - 1 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded  Garlic ranch butter - 1 stick unsalted butter, softened  - 2 tbsp parsley, chopped - 2 tbsp Parmesan cheese  - 2 tsp garlic paste - 1 1/2 tsp ranch seasoning  - 1 tsp garlic powder - Salt and pepper to taste  Bread - 1 large loaf French bread or Italian bread, halved Instructions - Preheat oven to 400°F - In a large bowl, add diced chicken drizzle olive oil and add Chicka Licka Bam Bam seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, salt and pepper to taste.  - Cover and marinate for 30 minutes. - Heat a skillet with a little oil over medium-high - Add chicken in a single layer. Let it sear for 4-5 minutes before stirring. - Cook until fully done and slightly golden - Lower heat and mix in buffalo sauce  and crema - Stir until creamy and fully coated - Cover and let it simmer for 10 minutes. - Mix butter ingredients  - Slice the loaf in half lengthwise, spread on bread, add cheese, diced chicken, and a drizzle of sauce from the chicken. - Add to the oven for 15-20 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly. - Garnish with parsley and extra buffalo sauce - Slice and serve warm. • • • #recipe #dinnerideas #garlicbread #recipeideas #chickenrecipes

Butter Chicken!!  Ingredients The chicken 2 lb chicken breast or thigh, cut into bite size pieces ⅓ cup greek yogurt  2 tsp kashmiri chile powder 2 tsp garam masala  1 ½ tsp turmeric  2 tsp garlic grated  2 tsp ginger grated 1 tsp fenugreek leaves 1 Tbsp olive oil The juice of 1 lemon 1 tsp salt The sauce 3 Tbsp ghee 4 cardamom pods 4 cloves 1 piece of cinnamon stick 4 cloves garlic, sliced 1 inch knob ginger, sliced 1 green chile, minced 24 oz crushed tomatoes ⅓ raw cashews  1 tsp kashmiri chile powder 2 tsp garam masala  1 cup cream 1 tsp fenugreek leaves Salt to taste To start in a bowl add the yogurt, kashmiri chile powder, garam masala, turmeric, garlic, ginger, fenugreek leaves, olive oil, lemon and salt. Mix well then add the chicken mix again, then add to a wire rack lined sheet tray, spread it into one layer. Broil for about 10 minutes until lightly charred. For the sauce in a large pan over medium high heat add the ghee then toast the spices for 2 minutes. Then remove them. Add the chili, garlic and ginger. Cook for 1-2 until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cashews, simmer for 10 minutes then blend until smooth. Add that back to the pan and add cream, kashmiri chili powder, garam masala, fenugreek and salt to taste. Add the chicken into the sauce and reheat it for 2-3 minutes. Serve with garlic naan and garnish with cilantro.  Enjoy!!

If there is one meal that belongs on your fall dinner table, it’s a cozy pot roast. Slow cooked until tender, served over creamy mashed potatoes and finished with a rich broth. It’s the ultimate comfort meal for fall 🍂 Full recipe down below, you can also find it in the link in my bio 🤎  Beef pot roast Ingredients: 	⁃	2-3 lb chuck roast 	⁃	1 medium white onion, sliced 	⁃	3 celery stalks, diced 	⁃	3 large carrots, sliced  	⁃	Bite size potatoes 	⁃	5 garlic cloves, minced 	⁃	Rosemary  	⁃	Thyme 	⁃	2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 	⁃	3 tbsp tomato paste 	⁃	2 Au jus gravy packets 	⁃	6 cups beef bone broth 	⁃	3 tbsp unsalted butter 	⁃	2 tbsp onion powder 	⁃	2 tbsp garlic powder 	⁃	Salt to taste Instructions: Wash and prep all of your vegetables. Peel and dice the carrots, slice the onion, mince the garlic, and dice the celery. Season the chuck roast to your liking. I used onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Make sure to season all sides of the roast. Add oil to a Dutch oven and sear the roast on all sides for 3–4 minutes per side. Remove the roast from the pot and set aside. Add the celery and onion to the pot and cook over medium heat until the onion has caramelized. Add the minced garlic last to prevent it from burning. Add the tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, and gravy packets. Add ½ cup of beef broth to deglaze the pot, then pour in the remaining broth. Add the seasonings and taste to make sure everything is seasoned to your liking. Add the roast back to the pot, along with the carrots, potatoes, butter, and a bunch of rosemary and thyme tied together with butcher’s twine. Cover and place in a 350°F oven for 3 hours. About 30 minutes before the roast is finished, prepare the mashed potatoes. To assemble, add a bed of mashed potatoes to a plate, then top with the roast, potatoes, and carrots. Finish with some of the broth and fresh or dried parsley. Enjoy! 🤎 #fall #fallrecipes #potroast #cozyvibes #fallvibes

Creamy Pesto Chicken Pasta Bake ✨ My most viral recipe of 2024!  What a year it’s been. I’m truly so grateful for all the love and support you’ve shown me this year. Cheers to a delicious 2025!  Here’s how to make it: 1lb pasta of choice 1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes + oil 1lb chicken 1 tbsp butter 1/2 yellow onion, diced Salt and pepper, to taste 1 tsp red pepper flakes (to taste) 1 tsp smoked paprika (to taste) 1 tsp oregano (to taste) 6-8 cloves of garlic, minced (to taste) 2 cups heavy cream (room temp) 1-2 cups cooked broccoli  2 handfuls spinach 6-8 oz freshly shredded parmesan cheese (divided) 8 oz freshly shredded mozzarella (divided) 1/2 cup pesto, to taste (I recommend Costco brand) Parsley to garnish  1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Place the cream on the counter to come to room temp. 2. Boil your noodles in salted water a few minutes less than package instructions (al dente). Drain and set aside.  3. In a large oven-safe saucepan or dutch oven, heat 1 tbsp of sun-dried tomato oil over medium heat. Cook the chicken until it's no longer pink, then remove it from the pan and set it aside. Let it rest for a few minutes before cutting into bite-sized pieces. 4. In the same pan, melt the butter and add salt, pepper, red pepper, paprika, and oregano. Stir to toast, then toss in the onion and sauté for about 4 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 5. Turn heat to low, pour in the heavy cream and stir. Let it simmer for a couple of minutes to thicken slightly. 6. Add half of the parmesan and 1 cup of mozzarella cheese,  stir until the cheese is melted. 7. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes, cooked broccoli, spinach, chicken, cooked pasta, and pesto. 8. Top with the remaining mozzarella and parmesan cheese.  9. Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes, then broil for another 5 minutes, or until the top is golden and bubbly. 10. Sprinkle with fresh parsley, a little more parmesan, and enjoy! #pastabake #chickenpesto #pesto #pestopasta #pestochicken #pasta #pastarecipe #easyrecipe #easyrecipes #easymeal #easydinner #dinnerideas #dinner #foodtok #cooking

Cowboy butter steak bites ✨ My husband ate both of these plates and rated it a 10/10 😭 Ingredients  Steak - 2 pounds ribeye or sirloin steak, cubed - 1 tbsp neutral oil - 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce  - 2 tsp garlic powder  - Salt and pepper to taste (generous amount) “Caramelized” onions  - 1 large yellow onion, sliced - 1 tsp granulated sugar  - Heaping pinch of salt Cowboy butter - 12 tbsp unsalted butter - 5 garlic cloves, minced  - 1 shallot, minced  - 1 lemon, freshly squeezed - 1 tbsp Dijon mustard  - 1 heaping tbsp parsley, chopped - 1 heaping tbsp chives, chopped - 1 tsp thyme - 1 tsp cayenne powder (adjust to heat preference  - 1/2 tsp red chili flakes - 1/2 tsp smoked paprika  - Salt to taste  Instructions  - Toss cubed steak with oil, Worcestershire, garlic powder, and a generous amount of salt & pepper. Set aside while the pan heats. - Heat a skillet over medium heat with a little oil or butter. - Add onions, sugar, and salt. Cook 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft, golden, and jammy. Remove from pan and set aside. - Crank heat to medium-high/high. Add steak in a single layer (work in batches if needed). - Sear 2–3 minutes per side until deeply browned. Remove and set aside. Lower heat to medium. - Add butter to the same pan. Once melted, add garlic and shallot — cook ~30 seconds until fragrant. - Stir in lemon juice, Dijon, parsley, chives, thyme, cayenne, chili flakes, smoked paprika, and salt. - Add steak back to the pan. - Toss to coat in the butter sauce for 1–2 minutes. - Serve over creamy mashed potatoes and enjoy! • • • #recipe #steak #dinnerideas #food #steak

Throwback to this Honey Garlic Lemon Pepper Chicken Thighs recipe. The full recipe is posted below and can also be found in my cookbook Let’s Get Into It! Check out my cookbook through the link in my bio. Notes: If you are doubling the recipe, do not add more lemon slices to the sauce as it will become too bitter. Ingredients: •4 bone-in Chicken Thighs •2 tsp Lemon Pepper Seasoning •2 tsp Garlic Powder •2 tsp Smoked Paprika •1 tsp Kosher Salt •1 tsp Black Pepper •1 tsp Onion Powder •3 tbsp Olive Oil Sauce •2 tbsp Unsalted Butter •¼ cup Honey •4 slices of Lemon •4 tsp minced garlic •1 tbsp freshly squeezed Lemon Juice •2 tsp Low-Sodium Soy Sauce Instructions: Prepare the Chicken 1. Clean and pat the thighs dry. In a small bowl, combine the lemon pepper seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and onion powder. Stir in the olive oil to make a seasoning paste. Fully coat the thighs with the paste, spreading it underneath the thigh skin to flavor the meat. Transfer the chicken to a zip-top bag or a container with a lid. Let the thighs marinate for at least 2 hours or up to overnight. 2. When the chicken is done marinating, preheat the oven to 425°F (215°C). Line a large baking pan or 9x13-inch (23x33cm) baking pan with foil, set a baking rack in the pan, and coat the baking rack with nonstick cooking spray. 3. Place the thighs on the rack skin side down. Bake, uncovered. for 30 minutes. Turn over the thighs and continue to bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until cooked through. The internal temperature should be at least 165°F (75°C). When cutting into the chicken near the thickest section, all of the juices should run clear. While the chicken is baking we can prepare the sauce. Prepare the Sauce 4. In a large skillet over medium-low heat, melt the butter. When the butter is melted, add the honey, lemon slices, garlic, lemon juice, soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon water. Bring the sauce to a simmer, then cook, periodically stirring the sauce until it thickens, about 5 minutes. 5. When the chicken is done, brush the sauce all over both sides and bake for an additional 5 minutes, until the sauce has browned and turned sticky. Allow the thighs to cool for 3 to 5 minutes, then enjoy! #royaleeats

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Here is my One Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta Dinner 🤤🍝 full recipe on my website.  Crispy on the outside, juicy and full of flavor chicken over a rich, creamy, cheesy pasta. Easy comfort food made in one pot! No mess no stress dinner 😊 One Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta:  Ingredients Chicken 2 chicken breasts 1 tbsp olive oil 1–2 tbsp butter 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder Salt and black pepper, to taste Pasta & Sauce 8 oz dry rigatoni 24 oz heavy cream 24 oz chicken broth (add more if needed) 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1–2 cups shredded cheese of your choice (I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar) Optional Garnish Fresh parsley, chopped Grated Parmesan cheese Red pepper flakes Instructions Season the chicken: Coat the chicken breasts with olive oil, Cajun seasoning, smoked paprika, sweet paprika, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Let the chicken marinate in the refrigerator for 15–30 minutes for the best flavor. Cook the chicken: Heat a large pot or skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for about 2–3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and fully cooked. Remove the chicken from the pan and let it rest. Cook the pasta: In the same pot, add the rigatoni, heavy cream, chicken broth, 1–2 tbsp butter, and seasonings. Stir everything together, cover, and let the pasta simmer until al dente, stirring occasionally. Add more broth or cream if needed while the pasta cooks. Add the cheese: Once the pasta is cooked, add your shredded cheese and stir until melted and creamy. I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar, but feel free to use whatever cheese you have in the fridge. Finish and serve: Slice the rested chicken and place it on top of the creamy pasta. Garnish with fresh parsley, Parmesan cheese, or red pepper flakes if desired. #easyrecipe  #pasta #chicken #familydinner #onepot

Sweet chili garlic chicken tenders. Ingredients  1 lb chicken tenders For the wet batter: 1 1/2 cup butter milk 2 tbsp lemon juice  2 tbsp soy sauce  1/4 cup hot sauce  Salt to taste 1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tbsp onion powder  1 tbsp smoked paprika powder  1 tsp black pepper powder  For the dry batter: 2 cups all purpose flour 1/2 cup corn starch  2 tbsp baking powder  Salt to taste 1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tbsp onion powder  1 tbsp smoked paprika powder  1 tsp black pepper powder  For the sweet chili garlic sauce  1/3 cup honey  2 tbsp ketchup  1 tbsp soy sauce sauce  1 tbsp fresh lemon juice  1/4 cup hot sauce  1 tbsp chili garlic sauce  3 cloves garlic, minced Salt to taste 2 tbsp butter, cold For the ranch dressing  1/2 cup mayonnaise 1/4 cup sour cream 2 tbsp buttermilk 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp dried parsley 1/4 tsp dried dill 1/4 tsp black pepper 1 tsp lemon juice Salt to taste Method: Marinate chicken with buttermilk, lemon juice, soy sauce, hot sauce, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, black pepper, and salt. Mix well, cover, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or 2–4 hours for the best flavor and tenderness. In a bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, baking powder, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, black pepper, and salt. Remove chicken from the buttermilk mixture and coat well in seasoned flour, pressing the flour onto the chicken. Dip back into the reserved buttermilk marinade, then coat again in flour, pressing and squeezing the flour onto the chicken for a thick, craggy coating. Let rest for 5–10 minutes. Heat oil to 350°F and fry in batches for 4–6 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden and the chicken reaches 165°F. Transfer to a wire rack to keep crispy. For the sauce, add honey, ketchup, soy sauce, lemon juice, hot sauce, chili garlic sauce, garlic, and salt to a saucepan. Simmer over medium-low heat for 2–3 minutes until glossy and slightly thickened. Turn heat to low and whisk in the cold butter. Lightly brush the sweet chili garlic glaze over the chicken tenders. For the ranch, whisk everything together and refrigerate for 15–30 minutes. Serve with ranch and enjoy #recipe #chickentenders

Chicken alfredo tacos 🌮  For the chicken 1 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tsp smoked paprika powder  1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  1/2 tsp Italian seasoning  2 tbsp lemon juice  2 tbsp oil for marinating + more for cooking For the Alfredo sauce: 2 tbsp butter 1 tbsp all purpose flour  2 cloves fresh garlic, minced  1 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream Salt to taste  1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp garlic powder  1/2 cup milk 3/4 cup Parmesan cheese, freshly grated  To assemble  15-16 mini tacos 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Oil for lightly frying the tacos 1/4 cup parsley, freshly chopped for garnish  Method  Marinate the chicken with salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, Italian seasoning, lemon juice, and oil for 20–30 minutes. Cook until golden and set aside. In the same pan, melt the butter and sauté the garlic. Whisk in the flour, then add the heavy cream and milk. Season with salt, black pepper, and garlic powder. Simmer until slightly thickened, then stir in the Parmesan until smooth.  Add the cooked chicken to half of the sauce and toss to coat. Reserve half for later . Fill each tortilla with mozzarella, the chicken Alfredo mixture, and a little more mozzarella. Fold and pan-fry until golden and crispy on both sides. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve with extra Alfredo sauce for dipping. #recipe #tacos #alfredochicken

Butter Chicken Recipe 🍛🔥👇🏼  For chicken:   2 chicken breast   3 tbsp Greek yogurt   Minced ginger   1 tsp garlic powder, paprika, cayenne, salt, cumin   1/2 lemon   For sauce:   1 tbsp butter   1/2 onion   2 fresh cloves garlic   1/2 tsp paprika, cumin, salt and chicken bouillon powder (optional)   2 1/4 cup tomato passata   1-2 tsp sugar   1 cup heavy cream   2 tbsp butter   cilantro   First, we’re going to cut the chicken into small cubes and season it with the spices, fresh ginger, lemon, and Greek yogurt. Then in a pan, add oil and fry the chicken.   Meanwhile, finely chop the onion and garlic.   Once the chicken is ready, remove it from the pan. In the same pan, add a small piece of butter and fry the onion, garlic, and spices together for 5 minutes over low heat until softened. Then add the tomato passata, sugar, and heavy cream. Mix very well and cook for a couple of minutes, then add two small pieces of butter to make it extra creamy. Finally, add the fried chicken back in, mix everything together, and top with cilantro and a little heavy cream. Serve it with white rice and naan bread.   👀 Remember that seasonings are always to taste, so don’t be afraid to add more if needed. If it tastes too acidic from the tomato sauce, don’t forget to add sugar to balance the flavors. #butterchicken #easyrecipe #foodie

Brown sugar cinnamon poptart bars If you liked pop tarts as a kid you’re going to love these!! Made with only a few ingredients and they taste sooo good🥹! Try it and tag me! d’EATS -2 1/2 cups flour -1 tsp cinnamon -1 cup soft butter -1/2 cup brown sugar -1/4 cup powder sugar -1 egg -2 tsp vanilla Brown sugar filling -1/2 cup brown sugar -2 tbsp melted butter -2 tbsp all purpose flour  -1 tbsp cinnamon Icing -1 cup powder sugar -1 tsp vanilla -1 tsp cinnamon  -2 tbsp milk  How too: Start by preheating your oven to 350F  In a large bowl combine your butter, brown sugar and powder sugar. You can mix by hand but if you have a stand, or power mixer it will be easier. Mix until butter and sugar are creamed together. Add in your egg and vanilla and mix again.  Add in your flour and cinnamon and mix until a dough forms. It may seem dry at first but keep mixing! Split your dough in half and add 1/2 to a lined 8x8 baking dish. Press dough until it is flat. Take the other 1/2 of the dough and press it into an 8x8 square on a piece of parchment paper.  Make your brown sugar cinnamon filling but mixing all ingredients in a small bowl. Add to your 8x8 baking dish then top with the other half of your dough.  Bake in the oven on 350F for 40 minutes.  Allow your poptart to cool for 15 minutes before icing them! Enjoy! #fyp #foryou #recipe #recipes #viralvideo

ive been on an old bay kick 🤤 recipe 👇🏻 For the Chicken Wings: * About 2 pounds chicken wings * 1 tablespoon baking powder * 1 teaspoon salt * 1/2 teaspoon black pepper * 1/2 teaspoon paprika * 2 tablespoons olive oil For the Old Bay Butter Sauce: * 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted * 2 tablespoons hot honey (adjust to taste for desired spice level) * 1 teaspoon Old Bay seasoning (adjust to taste) Instructions: 1. Prepare the Chicken Wings: a. Preheat your oven to 350°F. b. In a large bowl, combine the baking powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Mix well. c. Pat the chicken wings dry with paper towels to remove excess moisture. d. Toss the dry chicken wings in the spice mixture until they are evenly coated. e. Drizzle the vegetable oil over the wings and toss again to ensure they are coated evenly. 2. Bake the Chicken Wings: a. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper to prevent sticking. b. Place the coated chicken wings on the parchment-lined baking sheet in a single layer, making sure they are not overcrowded. c. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. 3. Crisping the Wings: a. After the initial 30 minutes, carefully flip the chicken wings using tongs. b. Increase the oven temperature to 425-450°F  c. Continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes or until the wings are golden brown and crispy. You may want to check them after 5 minutes to gauge how much longer they need. 4. Make the Hot Honey Butter Sauce: a. While the wings are in the oven, prepare the sauce by mixing warm melted butter, hot honey and old bay seasoning in a bowl. b. Taste and adjust the amount of hot honey and Old Bay to your liking for the desired level of heat and flavor. 5. Coat the Crispy Wings: a. When the wings are done baking and crispy, remove them from the oven and let them sit for 3 minutes so they stay crispy.  b. While the wings are still hot, transfer them to a large mixing bowl.  c. Pour the hot honey butter sauce over the wings and toss to coat them evenly. #gameday #gamedayfood #oldbay #oldbayseasoning #wings #chickenwings

Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Banana Bread 🍌 For all of you asking about the app, search “Osta Recipes” on the app or Google play store ‼️🫶 I have tested over 100 banana bread recipes and after countless adjustments, these officially have claimed the #1 spot 👑 Ingredients -3 ripe bananas (brown spots = flavor) -9 tbsp unsalted butter (browns down to ~½ cup) -1 large egg, room temp -¾ cup brown sugar -¼ cup white sugar -1½ cups all-purpose flour -1 tsp baking soda -½ tsp baking powder -½ tsp salt -1 tsp cinnamon -1 tsp vanilla extract or paste -1 to 1½ cups semi-sweet chocolate chips (measure with your heart) Instructions: 1. Add butter to a saucepan over medium heat. Stir often. It’ll melt, foam, sizzle, then turn golden with a nutty smell. Once browned (do not burn), pour into a  bowl and place in the freezer for 5 mins. You want it warm, not hot. 2. In a large bowl, mash bananas until mostly smooth. Add 1/2 cup of the browned butter, brown sugar, white sugar, egg, and vanilla. Whisk for 1 to 2 mins until glossy. 3. Add flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon. You can mix these in a separate bowl first, or be lazy like me and add them straight in. Just mix very thoroughly so everything is evenly distributed. 4. Preheat to 350°F / 175°C. Once no dry flour remains, fold in about 1 cup of chocolate chips. Save the rest for topping. 5. Line or grease a loaf pan and pour in the batter. Sprinkle remaining chocolate chips on top. Bake for 60 mins, loosely covering with foil halfway through to prevent over-browning. 6. Insert a toothpick into the center. It should come out with a few moist crumbs, not wet batter. If needed, bake an extra 5 to 10 mins. 7. Let cool slightly, then slice. Enjoy 🤠 #bananabread #bakingrecipe #recipe #easyrecipe #cookingathometiktoktv

Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. Remove and set aside.  3. Make the sauce Add all the cooked chicken back to the skillet. Pour in honey, soy sauce, ginger paste, and minced garlic. Toss to coat.  4. Simmer Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens and gets sticky, coating all the chicken.  5. Finish & serve Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over white rice with your favorite veggie.  #yum #easyrecipe #chicken

Chicken Spaghetti is an easy 30 minute dinner my family loves!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, and garlic powder  1 tbsp olive oil  1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper  1 tsp each of onion powder, parsley, and paprika  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1 tbsp of minced garlic 10 oz can of Rotel (not drained) 2 cups of shredded cheese (I used Colby Jack) 1/4 cup of sour cream  1 lb of spaghetti  INGREDIENTS  Cook spaghetti following the directions on the box.  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken lightly with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder.  Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add some olive oil. Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until both sides are golden brown and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of at least 165 degrees F.  Once the chicken is cooked, remove it from the skillet. Shred the chicken or cut it up into cubes and set aside.  In the skillet, add 3 tbsp of butter. Add 3 tbsp of flour and stir. Let the flour and butter cook for at least minute. Next, pour 2 cups of chicken broth into the skillet. Add 1 tbsp of minced garlic, salt, pepper, onion powder, parsley, and paprika. Stir everything together well.  Once this mixture starts to thicken, add 1 can of rotel (not drained), about 2 cups of shredded Colby Jack cheese and 1/4 cup of sour cream. Stir.  Add the drained spaghetti noodles and the cut up chicken. Stir everything together well. Top with dried parsley.  Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out!  #easyrecipes #chicken #spaghetti #dinner #mealideas #familydinner

The high-protein, low-carb dinner I wish I knew about sooner… and best part, it only takes 15 minutes!! #RECIPE Enoki Beef Rolls 🍄 Ingredients (3-4 servings): 1 lb thinly sliced beef (I used “shabu shabu beef”) 7 oz enoki mushrooms 1 white onion, thinly sliced 1 tbsp oil (avocado oil preferred) 2 eggs, whisked Garnish: chopped green onions, sesame seeds Sauce: 1/3 cup water 1/4 cup soy sauce 1 tbsp sesame oil 1 garlic clove, minced Dash of pepper 🥩 Instructions: Prep the mushrooms – Trim the bottom 1-2 inches off the enoki mushrooms, rinse, and separate into small bundles. Roll it up – Lay out a slice of beef and roll each enoki bundle tightly inside. Repeat until all are wrapped. Make the sauce – Mix all sauce ingredients in a bowl and set aside. Sauté the onions – Heat oil in a large skillet over med-high heat, add onions, and cook for 3min until softened. Cook the rolls – Place the beef rolls over the onions in a single layer, pour in the sauce, cover, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low-med and simmer for 3min (until beef is cooked through). Add the eggs – Uncover, pour whisked eggs over the rolls, cover again, and cook for 1min.  Finish & serve – Salt to taste. Remove from heat, garnish with green onions and sesame seeds. honey chipotle chicken sandwiches ✨ i will be uploading a newer version of my bun recipe because i tweaked it a bit to make them even softer!  Ingredients  - 1.5 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast - 1 1/2 cups buttermilk  - 1/3 cup pickle juice - 1/4 cup hot sauce - 1 large egg - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder  - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder  - 1 1/2 tsp chipotle powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp mustard seed powder  - 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder  - Salt and pepper to taste  Dredge - 1 1/2 cups all purpose flour  - 1/2 cup cornstarch  - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder - 1 tsp smoked paprika - 1 tsp chipotle powder - 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder  - 1 sazon packet (optional) - 1/2 tsp mustard powder - Salt and pepper to taste  - Drizzle of marinade  Honey chipotle sauce - 1/2 cup honey - 3 tbsp chipotle peppers, blended - 1 tbsp unsalted butter - 2 tsp apple cider vinegar  - 1/2 tsp garlic powder  - 1/4 tsp smoked paprika  - Salt to taste Assembly - Brioche buns - Pickles - Ranch Instructions  - Cut/pound chicken into even sandwich-sized pieces and add to a large bowl. - Add butter milk, seasonings, 1 egg, pickle juice, hot sauce, and mix until well combined. Refrigerate for 3 hours minimum or overnight for best results. - Combine all dredge ingredients. Drizzle a little of the marinade into the flour and toss with spoon create those crispy, craggy pieces. - Remove chicken from the marinade and coat well in the dredge. Dip it back into the marinade, then into the dredge again, pressing the flour mixture firmly onto the chicken. Let the double-battered chicken rest for 10–12 minutes so the coating sticks. - Heat frying oil to 350°F. Fry chicken in batches until deeply golden and crispy and the center reaches 165°F. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. - For the honey chipotle sauce, add honey, blended chipotle peppers, butter, apple cider vinegar, garlic powder, smoked paprika and salt to a saucepan. Heat on low for 2–3 minutes, stirring until smooth and glossy. - Brush or drizzle the warm honey chipotle sauce over the freshly fried chicken. - Toast your brioche buns, add ranch, pickles, crispy honey chipotle chicken, and serve immediately.  • • • #recipe #recipeideas #chickenrecipe #sandwich

School Nights in the Slow Cooker  Part 4 | Crockpot Broccoli Cheddar Chicken Orzo  This is one of those easy dinners that feels like comfort food but is simple enough for a busy school night! Ingredients 1–1½ lbs chicken breast ½ sweet onion, diced ½ cup shredded carrots Chicka Licka Bam Bam Chicken Rub, to taste @Fire & Smoke Society  ½ tsp garlic powder ½ tsp onion powder 2 tsp chicken bouillon powder ½ tsp paprika ¼ tsp black pepper 1½ cups chicken broth 2 cups broccoli 1 cup orzo 1 (8 oz) block cheddar cheese, freshly shredded plus more for topping  ½ cup heavy cream Salt, to taste at the end Directions 1. Add the chicken, diced onion, shredded carrots, chicken rub, garlic powder, onion powder, chicken bouillon powder, paprika, black pepper, and chicken broth to your slow cooker. 2. Cover and cook on LOW for 4–5 hours or HIGH for 2–3 hours, until the chicken is cooked through and tender. 3. Remove the chicken, shred or chop it, and return it to the slow cooker. 4. Stir in the orzo, broccoli, heavy cream, and shredded cheddar. Cover and cook on HIGH for about 30 minutes, stirring once or twice, until the orzo is tender. Keep an eye on it toward the end since orzo can absorb liquid quickly. 5. Taste before adding any salt. The chicken bouillon and chicken rub already contain salt, so you may not need much! #easyrecipe #crockpot #slowcooker #dinnerideas #easydinner

Complete dinner in under 30 minutes✨ One pot, simple ingredients, minimal cleanup, and a dinner everyone actually gets excited about. Juicy chicken thighs, cozy penne pasta, and the freshest, creamiest side salad. These are the kinds of meals that end up on repeat in my kitchen because they’re easy, comforting, and just so good🥰 Ingredients 🐓🍝🥗 One pot chicken & pasta 1½ pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs/breast 1 onion, sliced ¼ cup olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon paprika 1 teaspoon garlic powder ½ teaspoon black pepper 1 package 16 oz penne pasta  4 cups chicken broth or any broth you love ½ cup tomato paste Side salad 🥒🍅🥑 4 Persian cucumbers, chopped About a cup of cherry tomatoes  1 shallot  1 avocado  Olive oil Fresh lemon juice  Fresh lime juice  Salt and pepper Instructions Place the chicken thighs in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Mix until evenly coated. Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add the chicken and sear for a few minutes on each side until golden. Scatter the sliced onion right over the chicken and let it soften in all the flavor. In a separate bowl or measuring cup, whisk together the broth and tomato paste until smooth. Once the chicken is nicely browned, add the pasta directly into the pot. Pour the tomato broth mixture right over the chicken and pasta and bring everything to a boil. Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 10 minutes until the pasta is tender and the chicken is fully cooked through. While everything cooks, chop the cucumbers cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, shallot, and avocado. Drizzle with olive oil and fresh lemon and lime juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss. That’s it. One pot, one fresh salad, and a full comforting dinner on the table in under 30 minutes💛 #sivanskitchen #easyrecipes #onepotmeal #dinnerideas #quickmeals

#recipeideas #gelatin  Gelatin is collagen just in a different form. Collagen is a structural protein found in animal tissues like skin, bones, and connective tissue. When you take that collagen and cook it (heat + water), it breaks down into gelatin. What actually happens: 	•	Collagen has a tight, triple-helix structure (very strong and rigid) 	•	When heated, that structure unwinds and partially breaks down 	•	This creates a softer, more digestible form → gelatin So when you see: “Unflavored natural gelatin (bovine)” 	•	“Bovine” = comes from cows 	•	“Unflavored” = no additives 	•	“Gelatin” = collagen that has been hydrolyzed by heat

One Pan Cheesy Parmesan Garlic Chicken & Rice 😮‍💨 INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breast, cut into cubes  2 tbsp butter  1 onion, chopped  1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper 1 tsp each of smoked paprika, onion powder, and Italian seasoning   1 tbsp minced garlic BWW Parmesan Garlic Sauce  2 cups of chicken broth  1 cup white jasmine rice, rinsed   1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese  2 oz cream cheese 4 pieces of bacon, cooked and crumbled Dried parsley  INSTRUCTIONS  If you don’t have any bacon leftover from breakfast cook your bacon, drain the grease, and chop it into small pieces. you guys asked so I’m delivering!! Crispy Smashed Potatoes with Kewpie-Ponzu Sauce! ⭐️💛 full recipe available on my substack (which is FREE) The recipe that disappears in seconds. You'll need: pee-wee Dutch yellow potatoes, avocado oil (I use Lula), garlic, Kewpie mayo, ponzu, Dijon, lemon, shallot, chives, parsley, green onion, red pepper flakes, salt How: 1. Brine potatoes in salted cold water, 20 min 2. Boil until fork-tender, drain 3. Smash flat on a parchment-lined tray 4. Coat in avocado oil and minced garlic 5. Roast at 400°F for 25-30 min, then 425°F for 5-10 min until deep golden and crisp 6. Salt immediately out of the oven 7. Whisk Kewpie mayo, ponzu, Dijon, lemon juice, chives, parsley, shallot, half the green onions, and red pepper flakes 8. Toss potatoes in sauce, top with remaining green onion, serve immediately Full recipe and oil link in bio. #crispypotatoes #viralrecipe

🌮 15-Minute Air Fryer Chicken Fajitas One of the easiest meals you’ll make all week. Just season, air fry, and serve! Ingredients: Chicken breast or thighs (sliced), bell peppers, onion, olive oil, salt, garlic powder, ginger powder, chilli flakes, smoked paprika, fajita seasoning. How I Made It: 1️⃣ Add the chicken, peppers, and onion to the air fryer basket. 2️⃣ Sprinkle over the salt, garlic powder, ginger powder, chilli flakes, smoked paprika, and fajita seasoning. 3️⃣ Drizzle with olive oil and toss until everything is evenly coated. 4️⃣ Air fry at 200°C for 15 minutes, giving it a shake halfway through. 5️⃣ Serve in tortillas with your favourite sauce or dressing and finish with a little parsley. Recipe Name Creamy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Breast Ingredients 1. 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts 2. 2 tbsp olive oil 3. 2 tbsp butter 4. 4 garlic cloves, minced 5. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 6. 1 tsp paprika 7. 1 tsp salt 8. 1/2 tsp black pepper 9. 1 cup heavy cream 10. 1/2 cup chicken broth 11. 3/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese 12. 1 tsp garlic powder 13. 1 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Recipe 1. Season the chicken with salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Sear the chicken for 5–6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. 4. Remove the chicken and keep warm. 5. Melt the butter in the same pan. 6. Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant. 7. Pour in the chicken broth and heavy cream, stirring well. 8. Add Parmesan cheese and cook until the sauce becomes smooth and creamy. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. 10. Simmer for 3–5 minutes so the flavors combine. 11. Garnish with fresh parsley. 12. Serve with mashed potatoes, pasta, or roasted vegetables. Follow for more delicious recipes!

High Protein Cheesy Honey Chipotle Chicken Quesadillas🔥🍯🍗 65g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros: Per Serving - 10 Total) 484 Calories 33C | 14gF | 65gP Ingredients: 1.8KG Boneless & Skinless Chicken Breast (raw weight) 1.5 Packets Chipotle Seasoning (homemade or Cholula Chipotle Seasoning) 1 Tsp Olive Oil 400g Low Fat Cottage Cheese 2 Tsp Chipotle Seasoning (Cholula) 80ml Light Mayonnaise (Heinz) 2 Garlic Cloves 1/2 Juiced Lime 2 Tsp Chipotle In Adobo Sauce (La Costena) 80ml Buffalo Sauce (Franks Redhot Buffalo Sauce) 100g Honey 40g Light Grated Cheese Diced Chives 10 Tortillas (Mission Carb Balance Tortillas) 40g Light Grated Cheddar Cheese (Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Cheese - per quesadilla) Directions: 1. Start by seasoning your chicken breast with chipotle seasoning, olive oil & mix. 2. Using a stove with the pan on medium heat cook the chicken with a lid for approximately 8 - 10 minutes per side or until fully cooked through, once cooked shred the chicken apart using 2 forks. 3. In a blender cup add low fat cottage cheese, chipotle seasoning, light mayonnaise, garlic, lime juice, chipotle in adobo sauce, buffalo sauce, honey & blend for 2 minutes until smooth & creamy. 4. In a large bowl combined the blended chipotle sauce, shredded chicken, chives & grated cheese until well combined. 5. Place a warm tortilla down & to one half add a layer of cheese followed by 1/10th of the filling, another layer of cheese & fold. 6. Toast on a pan on each side until golden brown & crispy, repeat for the other 9 quesadillas.  #quesadilla #chicken #highprotein #healthyrecipes #mealprep

Day 31 of sharing easy dinner recipes! 🍽️ This one is easy, delicious, and perfect for a busy weeknight dinner!  Crockpot Marry Me Chicken Sandwiches INGREDIENTS 1 lb chicken breast  1/2 tsp each salt, pepper, oregano, thyme 1 tsp each onion powder and garlic powder 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes 1 tbsp minced garlic 1/3 cup sun dried tomatoes, chopped  1/2 cup of chicken broth  8 slices of bacon  1 block of cream cheese 1 cup of shredded mozzarella cheese Brioche buns  INSTRUCTIONS  Spray a crockpot with cooking spray and add the chicken. Season the chicken with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, onion powder, garlic powder, and red pepper flakes. Next, add the minced garlic, chopped sun dried tomatoes, and chicken broth.  Be sure to stir the sun dried tomatoes and garlic around. You want the sun dried tomatoes to be down in the chicken broth, so they don’t burn.  Cook on low for 4-6 hours. Once the chicken is fully cooked shred the chicken, add a block of cream cheese, and shredded mozzarella cheese. Let this keep cooking on low until the cream cheese is melted and stir everything together well.  Cook bacon while cream cheese is melting. Once bacon is cooked build sandwiches on toasted buns and top with the crispy bacon. Enjoy!  #easyrecipes #dinnerideas #crockpot

videos.caption: Quick and easy cinnamon roll bites 😮‍💨😋 Ingredients: Pillsbury Grands biscuits  ⅓ cup unsalted butter, melted ⅓ cup granulated sugar ½ tablespoon ground cinnamon 1½ cups powdered sugar ⅓ cup heavy whipping cream ½ tablespoon vanilla bean paste or extract Instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Using a 16.3-ounce can of Pillsbury Grands biscuits, cut each biscuit into quarters and gently roll each piece into a ball. Transfer the biscuit pieces to a mixing bowl. Add the melted butter and cinnamon sugar, then gently toss until each piece is evenly coated. Lightly spray a 9x9-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray or coat it with a thin layer of butter. Transfer the coated biscuit pieces to the baking dish and spread them out evenly. Bake at 350°F for 25–28 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. While the cinnamon roll bites are baking, prepare the icing. In a bowl, whisk together 1½ cups of powdered sugar, ⅓ cup of heavy whipping cream, and about ½ tablespoon of vanilla bean paste or vanilla extract. For a thicker icing, add more powdered sugar. For a thinner consistency, add a little more heavy whipping cream. Let the cinnamon roll bites cool for about 5 minutes before drizzling or spreading the icing over the top. EASY MEALS FOR 2, EP. 24 🍯 Honey Garlic Chicken Ingredients Chicken * 375g-400g boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces * 1 tsp salt * 1 tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp black pepper * ¼ cup cornstarch Sauce * 60g honey (about 3 tbsp) * 2 tbsp soy sauce * 1 tbsp oyster sauce * 1 tbsp rice vinegar * 19g garlic, minced (4–5 large cloves) * 12g green onion whites, finely sliced Cornstarch Slurry * 1 tsp cornstarch * 2 tsp water Garnish * Sesame seeds * Sliced green onion greens Directions 1. Toss the chicken with the salt, garlic powder, pepper, and cornstarch until evenly coated. 2. Heat enough neutral oil to lightly coat the bottom of a pan. Shallow fry the chicken over medium-high heat until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. 3. Reduce to medium heat. If needed, add a little more oil, then sauté the garlic and green onion whites for 30–60 seconds until fragrant. 4. Pour in the honey, soy sauce, oyster sauce, and rice vinegar. Simmer for 1–2 minutes. 5. Stir in the cornstarch slurry and cook until the sauce thickens. 6. Return the chicken to the pan and toss until every piece is well coated. 7. Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions greens Serve with steamed rice and enjoy! 🍚 #honeygarlicchicken #chickenrecipe #easyrecipe #cooking #creatorsearchinsights

Save this for an easy weeknight meal you’ll keep coming back to 🌯💛 RECIPE⬇️ Creamy Chicken Mushroom Wraps Servings: 4 wraps Prep Time: 15 minutes Cook Time: 20 minutes Ingredients: For the Chicken: * 2 chicken breasts, diced * 1 tbsp olive oil * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp smoked paprika * ½ tsp black pepper * ½ tsp salt For the Mushroom Mixture: * 1 tbsp butter * 1 cup mushrooms, sliced * ½ medium onion, finely chopped For the Secret Sauce: * ¼ cup mayonnaise * 2+ tbsp creamy pasta sauce * 1 tsp sriracha (adjust to taste) Additional Ingredients: * 1 cup spinach, chopped * ¼ cup fresh cilantro, chopped * ½ cup shredded cheese (mozzarella, cheddar, or a blend) * 4 large tortillas Instructions: 1. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the diced chicken and season. Cook for 8–10 minutes, or until the chicken is fully cooked and golden brown. Remove from heat and set aside. 2. In the different pan, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the sliced mushrooms and chopped onions, and sauté for about 5 minutes, or until softened and golden brown. 3. Add in the mayonnaise, creamy pasta sauce, and sriracha. 4. Return the cooked chicken to the pan with the mushroom mixture. Stir in the spinach and cilantro. Add the shredded cheese and stir until melted and combined. 5. Place a tortilla flat on a clean surface. Spoon a generous amount of the chicken and mushroom filling into the center. Fold in the sides and roll up tightly to form a wrap. 6. Heat a dry skillet over medium heat. SKŁADNIKI: 20 płatów ciasta do pierożków dim sum 500 g mielonej wieprzowiny 1 marchewka duża garść szczypiorku 6 ząbków czosnku 1 łyżka startego imbiru 2 łyżki sosu sojowego 2 łyżki sosu ostrygowego 1 łyżka oleju sezamowego 1 łyżeczka cukru trzcinowego 1 łyżeczka soli 125 ml bulionu warzywnego PRZYGOTOWANIE: 1. Marchewkę zetrzyj, szczypiorek drobno posiekaj, a czosnek przeciśnij przez praskę. 2. Do mielonej wieprzowiny dodaj marchewkę, szczypiorek, czosnek i starty imbir. 3. Dodaj sos sojowy, sos ostrygowy, olej sezamowy, cukier trzcinowy i sól. Całość dokładnie wymieszaj. 4. Porcję farszu nakładaj na środek ciasta do dim sum i dokładnie zlepiaj pierożki. 5. Pierożki ułóż na patelni i podsmażaj na średnim ogniu przez około 2 minuty, aż spód zacznie się rumienić. 6. Wlej 125 ml bulionu warzywnego, przykryj patelnię i gotuj przez około 16 minut. 7. Zdejmij pokrywkę i gotowe! Najlepiej smakują polane olejem chili lub dodatkowym sosem sojowym. videos.caption: Meals for Weight-loss: Ep 8 Honey Garlic Chicken 640 cals, 58g protein, 54 carbs, 12 fat per serving Makes 4 servings You can find all my recipes link in bio!  You would think this is unhealthy but its perfect for meal prep and its SO GOOD! Here is how I made it: 1. Add 1.5 cups jasmine rice and 2.25 cups water to a rice cooker and cook according to the rice cooker settings. 2. In a large bowl, combine 800 g chicken breast, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp cornstarch, and 1 tsp black pepper. Mix until the chicken is evenly coated and let it marinate for 20-30 minutes. 3. Air fry the chicken at 400°F for 10-12 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through, until cooked through and lightly caramelized. 4. Heat 1 tbsp avocado oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add 4 cloves minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add 600 g broccoli florets and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes. Pour in 2-3 tbsp water, cover for 1 minute, then uncover and season with 1 tbsp soy sauce, ½ tsp black pepper, and a pinch of salt. Toss everything together for another 1-2 minutes, then set aside. 5. In the same wok, add 4 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, and ¾ cup water. Bring to a simmer. Mix 2 tsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp water and stir it into the sauce. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens. Add the cooked chicken and toss until every piece is coated. 6. Divide the rice, broccoli, and honey garlic chicken between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds. Now it’s time to enjoy! #healthyrecipes #mealprep #healthyfoodshare #amateurprochef #takeoutrecipes

Creamy Chipotle Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍟🧀 One of the most indulgent meal prep recipes, so creamy, rich in flavour and packed with protein. Using a sheet pan is a game changer for batch cooking🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 548 Calories | 51g Protein | 52g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Chipotle Chicken Marinade - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Parsley - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 100g Chipotle Paste - 1 and 1/2 Limes, juiced - 30g or 6 Tsp Olive Oil Let this marinate overnight if possible, way more flavor! Crispy Seasoned Potatoes - 1300g Raw Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 2.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Onion Powder - Avocado Cooking Spray, heavy pass Creamy Chipotle Sauce - 20g Light Butter - 150-200g Red Onion, finely chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 60-80g Chipotle Paste (depends how spicy you want it) - 400g Light Evaporated Milk - 110g Light Cream Cheese - Freshly Chopped Parsley, garnish 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a large pan on low, add butter and chopped red onion. Cook for 5-7 mins until softened and lightly browned. Add seasonings and chipotle paste, mix, and cook for another 5 mins until caramelised. 3. Keep the heat low, add evaporated milk and cream cheese. Stir continuously until smooth, rich, and creamy. 4. Cube up potatoes, add seasoning and cooking spray, then mix well. Spread on a lined sheet pan and roast at 200C / 390F for 25 mins until golden and crispy. Season with salt, then fold into the sauce with fresh parsley until fully coated. 5. Spread marinated chicken on sheet pan, oven bake 25 mins 200C / 390F until golden and juicy. Cut into cubes, serve with creamy potatoes and ENJOY! . . . . #chipotle #chickenrecipes #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes

Tender stewed chicken and gravy recipe: Cook time: 80-90 mins  Servings: 6 Ingredients:  1/2 yellow onion  1/2 green bell pepper  1/2 red bell pepper  4 crushed garlic cloves  1/2 stick butter or olive oil  2 TBSP All purpose flour   6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs  4 cups of chicken broth  Dried parsley  Seasonings: all purpose seasoning (such as natures seasoning or lawrys) onion & garlic powders, paprika, Italian seasoning, black pepper and if you don’t mind some spice toss in some Slap ya mama.  Directions: Season about 6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs (depending on how many you’re serving) with all named seasonings. Marinate from 1 hour up to overnight. The longer the better. Use a Dutch oven or stock pot to sear the chicken in 2 TBSP of butter or olive oil. Sear for about 2-3 mins on each side on a medium high heat.  Remove chicken from pot. If you see little dark bits and pieces at the bottom of the pot leave it. It’s not burnt. That’s flavor that you want to keep in your pot to make the meal even more flavorful. It will deglaze and cook into the stew once you add your chicken broth.  In the same pot (without washing) on a medium heat add 1-2 TBSP of butter (depending on how much oil or butter you have left from searing the chicken). Add your peppers, onions and seasonings and cook down your peppers and onions for about 8-10 mins or until tender.  Once tender while still on a medium heat add in 1 TBSP of butter and whisk in 2 tbsp of flour to make a roux. Whisk frequently. Don’t walk away from your roux because this is A quick roux and can burn easily so watch it closely.  After about 5 mins you should have the color roux you want your gravy to be. For example if you want a dark brown gravy that roux should be dark brown.  After you’ve achieved that color add in 3 cups of chicken broth 1 cup at a time while stirring in between each cup. Season to taste with named seasonings.  Add in 3-4 crushed garlic cloves and a hefty TBSP of parsley. Put the lid on partially to bring this gravy to a simmer on a medium heat.  After about 10 mins add your chicken in and let it cook on a medium heat for 1 hour. Check it every 10 mins to make sure it doesn’t need more liquid. After your chicken is tender to your preference serve over rice or however you prefer.  **I served mine over white rice with loose, seasoned buttery corn and A blueberry loaf bread I made in the oven using Martha white blueberry cheesecake mix.  Enjoy ♥️

Roux: ½ cup butter (113g) ½ cup flour (60g) 3 garlic cloves 1 chicken bouillon cube, grated Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper 1 tsp smoked paprika Melt the butter, add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Whisk in the flour and cook for 60–90 seconds. Add the grated chicken bouillon cube, then slowly add your milk and cream while whisking until it thickens. Sauce: 3 cups whole milk (720g) 1 cup heavy cream (240g) 3–4 cups shredded cheese (340–450g) — fontina, mozzarella, cheddar Take it off the heat and add your cheese 1 cup at a time until smooth. Pasta: 2 packs Barilla pasta (340g each) Boil the pasta just under al dente, drain and mix it into your cheese sauce. Add the chicken and mix everything together. Put it into a baking dish and cover the top with extra cheese… measure that with your eyes 😂 Bake at 375°F for 15 minutes, then broil on high for 3 minutes. Plate it up and finish with freshly grated Parmesan. 🧀

videos.caption: 😮‍💨 263 Cal Chicken Caesar Salad Chalupas 📍 My high protein chalupa series has been super viral and I think I might’ve the best one yet! ✅ Macros for each Chalupa: 263 Cals, 15g Carbs, 8g Fat, 36g Protein ✅ Macros (32g) Caesar Dressing: 29 Cals, 0.5g Carbs, 1.75g Fat, 3g Protein ✳️ 29 Cal Caesar Dressing:  227g Plain Non Fat Greek yogurt Juice from ½ Fresh Lemon 14g Olive Oil 30g Worcestershire sauce 10g Dijon Mustard 24g Grated parmesan cheese 3 garlic cloves, minced 1/4 teaspoon Kosher salt Water to desired consistency ✳️ Caesar Salad: 300g Romaine 1/6th Batch Caesar Dressing ✳️ Ingredients for Chicken Caesar Dip: 16oz Chicken Breast 1 ½ tsp Garlic Powder 1 tsp Onion Powder 1 tsp Salt ½ tsp Black Pepper ½ tsp Paprika ½ tsp Dried Parsley 1/6th Batch Caesar Dressing ✳️ Ingredients for 1 Chalupa: 1 Josephs Pita 4g Parmesan 12g Part Skim Mozzarella 1/4th Batch of Chicken Caesar Dip Cooking Spray (added 1g fat to macro per chalupa) ❇️ Directions: 1️⃣ Take your chicken breast and pat dry with a paper towel. Then flatten. I just use my fist lol. 2️⃣ Then season both sides with seasoning mix recipe above. Air fry on 400 degrees F for 9-10 minutes. 3️⃣ While that’s cooking, make your caesar dressing by adding all your ingredients into a bowl and mixing. 4️⃣ Now chop up your chicken breast once done and add to a bowl. Combine with the buffalo caesar dressing 1/6th caesar dressing. 5️⃣ Chop up 300g romaine and add 1/6th caesar dressing to it. Can add more but we don’t want the romaine to be soggy. 6️⃣ Now put together your chalupas. Lay one pita down then add to on side 6g mozzarella, 2g parmesan, 1/4th of your chicken caesar dip, 2g parmesan, 6g mozzarella. 7️⃣ Fold your chalupa tightly. Spray both sides with cooking spray and add to air fryer on 400 degrees F for 4 minutes. I added some ramekins on top of each one to make sure they stayed closed while in the air fryer. 8️⃣ Once done, open them up, add your caesar salad and enjoy! #caesarsalad #chalupa #airfryer #highproteinmeals#mealprep

Once it begins to turn brown, remove from heat. 2.Allow butter to cool. Once cooled stir in brown sugar and granulated sugar, eggs and vanilla extract until fully combined & color starts to lighten. 3.In a seperate bowl (or the same works for me), combine flour, baking soda, and salt. 4. Once wet and dry ingredients are combined, then fold in chocolate chips and Cadbury eggs. 6.Scoop out dough. (I used a 2inch cookie scoop). Add some extra crush Cadbury eggs and mini chips on top for a nicer look. Then refrigerate a minimum of 30 minutes to overnight.  7.Bake at 350 in the center rack for 14-16 minutes or until edges begin to brown. #chocolatechipcookies #brownbutter #cookies #cadbury #easter

Add diced chicken and season with Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Cook until browned and cooked through. Add minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. Add chicken broth, heavy cream, sun dried tomatoes and crushed red pepper flakes. Season the sauce with Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Stir to combine. Add the uncooked gnocchi directly to the pan. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the gnocchi is tender and the sauce has thickened. Recipe Name French Onion Meatloaf with Melted Mozzarella Ingredients 1. 2 lbs (900 g) ground beef 2. 1 cup breadcrumbs 3. 2 large eggs 4. 1 small onion, finely diced 5. 2 large onions, thinly sliced 6. 3 garlic cloves, minced 7. 1/3 cup milk 8. 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 9. 2 tbsp ketchup 10. 1 tsp Dijon mustard 11. 1 tsp salt 12. 1 tsp black pepper 13. 1 tsp garlic powder 14. 1 tsp dried thyme 15. 2 tbsp butter 16. 1 tbsp olive oil 17. 1 cup beef broth 18. 1 tbsp all-purpose flour 19. 1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese 20. 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Recipe 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Lightly grease a loaf pan or baking dish. 2. Heat the butter and olive oil in a skillet. Add the sliced onions and cook over medium-low heat for 20–25 minutes until deeply caramelized. 3. Stir in the garlic and cook for 1 minute. Sprinkle in the flour, then add the beef broth and simmer until slightly thickened. Remove from the heat. 4. In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, breadcrumbs, eggs, diced onion, milk, Worcestershire sauce, ketchup, Dijon mustard, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and thyme. 5. Mix gently until just combined, then shape into a loaf and place in the prepared pan. 6. Bake for 40 minutes. 7. Remove the meatloaf from the oven and spoon the caramelized onion mixture evenly over the top. 8. Sprinkle the mozzarella cheese generously over the onions. 9. Return the meatloaf to the oven and bake for another 15–20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted, bubbly, and lightly golden. 10. Let the meatloaf rest for 10 minutes before slicing. 11. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley for extra flavor and color. 12. Serve hot with creamy mashed potatoes and your favorite vegetables. Follow for more delicious and easy recipes!

Get the recipe below or tap the link in @allrecipes bio to try it for yourself! 🍽️ Ingredients:  4 ounces cream cheese, softened 1/2 cup sour cream 1 cup shredded Monterey Jack cheese, divided 1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted 1/4 cup brine from pepperoncini peppers 1 (1-ounce) package ranch dressing mix 1 (1-ounce) package au jus gravy mix 1 cup milk 3 cups wide egg noodles (6 ounces), cooked according to package directions 3 cups shredded cooked chicken 1 cup sliced pepperoncini peppers Directions:  Gather all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a 2-quart baking dish with cooking spray. Stir together cream cheese, sour cream, 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese, melted butter, pepperoncini brine, ranch dressing mix, and au jus gravy mix in a large bowl until well combined. Stir in milk. Fold in cooked noodles, chicken, and pepperoncini peppers until evenly coated. Spread mixture into the prepared baking dish; sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese. VIRAL CHUCK ROAST✨ my most popular recipe for good reason! I’ve received 100s of messages from you about how this recipe has become a staple in your family’s dinner routine 🥹 Some of you are making it WEEKLY and I’ve gotten so much feedback specifically that your kids are loving it - which makes me so happy! Let me know in the comments how YOU enjoy this easy recipe and share it with someone you think would love this crowd-pleasing chuck roast!  Ingredients: 1 boneless beef chuck roast (about 4 pounds) 2 teaspoons kosher sea salt  1 teaspoon black pepper  Instructions: Preheat your oven to 325. Season the roast generously on both sides with salt and pepper. Add to a baking large casserole dish or Dutch oven, cover (with a lid or foil), and bake for 1 hr per pound of meat. Remove the roast from the oven and raise the oven temperate to 425.  Using two forks, shred the meat into large chunks. (If the roast is not pulling apart easily, put it back in the oven for 30 min). Toss the shredded pieces of roast around in the rendered fat and place it back in the oven, uncovered, for 20-25 minutes until you see some nice crispy ends.  Serve with mashed potatoes or roasted vegetables and enjoy! FAQs:  My roast is less than 4 lbs, how long should I cook it? Use the “hour per pound” method. How do I choose a good beef chuck roast? Look for nice fatty roast with lots of marbling. A roast that is too lean will not render enough juice. (Note: I have hit or miss luck with grass-fed roasts. Most are just too tough/lean and don't render enough fat for this preparation.)  How many people does this serve? A 4-pound roast serves 6-7 people. Do I need to sear it first?  Nope! The last part of the cook will give it some nice crispy bits without searing.  Did you add liquid? No, that is the juice rendered from the meat. Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

Only 597 Calories!🍯🧄🍗 Made By: @Jalalsamfit  For All The Best & Simple High Protein Recipes In One Place Follow: @legends_cooking Follow My Main Account: @Mykhaylo  Macros: 597 Calories 59g Protein 52g Carbs 16g Fat Ingredients & Cooking Directions: Make 4 Servings Honey Garlic Chicken: 800g Raw Chicken Breast cut into cubes 1.5 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (leave it out if you don’t want it spicy) 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder 1.5 Tsp Onion Powder 1.5 Tep Paprika or Smoked Paprika 2 Tsp Olive Oil 30g Light Butter, for cooking + extra once cooked 2 Tsp Minced Garlic 30g Honey (15g Honey per batch of chicken) Handful Fresh Chopped Parsley Get a pan on medium heat first then add butter.
